title: Clash of the Arena Beasts
front_description: A brief but amazing "battle of the giants" ensues in the execution arena. Herded into this vast stadium, three deadly creatures dash with everyone and everything in sight, from the jabbing picadors astride bellowing orrays, to Jedi Knights with more than a few amazing tricks up their sleeves. Clever maneuvering eventually pits creature against creature, with the condemned trio turning unexpected events to their advantage.
back_description: Doug Chiang's concept of an orray, saddled arena blasts mounted by Geonosian Picadors.
